name: Banner of the Fallen
objectiveText: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss . Banner of Ironforge (Provided)  ( 1 )   Headsplitter slain  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Pick the banner up and plunk it down exactly where you found it, next to [npc=269153]. A wave of level 12-14 troggs will start entering the cave from both sides one to two mobs at a time. Clear these waves, and [npc=269185] (level 16) will spawn and run towards you. The banner has only a 30 second cooldown and it doesn't disappear upon use, so if you miss the tag, you can just attempt again.

I did the quest twice, and both times the boss trogg spawned in at the side that leads to the ramp that starts from the cave entrance where [npc=1205] and his companions spawn in.

Turn into [npc=1092] at the Valley of Kings bunker where you get all the other trogg related quests (He gives [quest=267] & [quest=217] respectively). He's up top looking out a window facing the signpost.
Just putting this here incase you missed the info up top or under Quick Facts or wanted more specific info as I admit I was a bit confused at first glance on where to go.
